description: Native cold collisionless halo evolution and physical virial/inertia diagnostics.

cold_static_vp.profile_sampling: All positive native densities and finite centered21-bin slopes thin; centers with Neff>=32 thick.
cold_static_vp.endpoint_scope: Bound subset selected by full potential with zero at infinity and ratio measured in its own reconstructed field; positive energy includes both radial directions.

cold_expanding_vp.profile_sampling: All positive native densities and finite centered21-bin slopes thin; centers with Neff>=32 thick.
cold_expanding_vp.endpoint_scope: Full population only; inertia growth accompanies the instantaneous virial ratio.
